stories.title: Progress Kemp LoadMaster Flaw Hits CISA KEV After 792 Reported Exploit Attempts
stories.abstract: CISA has added a critical command injection vulnerability in Progress Kemp LoadMaster, tracked as CVE-2026-8037, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaw is currently being leveraged by threat actors to gain unauthorized control over affected network appliances.
stories.why: This vulnerability allows for remote code execution, granting attackers full control over critical load balancing infrastructure.
stories.action: Update Progress Kemp LoadMaster to a patched version immediately.

stories.title: Google security advisory (AV26-787)
stories.abstract: Multiple critical vulnerabilities affect Google Chrome, N-able N-central, and Django. Several flaws in Chrome and N-central are currently being exploited in the wild, necessitating immediate attention to patching cycles for these widely deployed enterprise and browser platforms.
stories.why: Active exploitation of these vulnerabilities poses a significant risk of remote code execution and system compromise within enterprise environments.
stories.action: Update Chrome to 151.0.7922.109, N-central to 2026.3 HF2, and Django to 6.0.8 or 5.2.17.

stories.title: Metabase Zero-Day Exploited in Wild Allows Admin Access Without Authentication
stories.abstract: A critical, unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in Metabase is currently being exploited in the wild. Attackers are leveraging this flaw to execute arbitrary commands against application databases, leading to unauthorized administrative access and potential data exfiltration from affected instances.
stories.why: The vulnerability carries a maximum severity rating and allows remote attackers to bypass authentication, posing an immediate risk of total system compromise.
stories.action: Update Metabase instances to the latest patched version immediately.

stories.title: CISA Flags TeamCity CVE-2026-63077 RCE Flaw Under Active Exploitation in the Wild
stories.abstract: CISA has added a critical deserialization vulnerability in on-premise JetBrains TeamCity servers to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-63077, allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems.
stories.why: TeamCity servers are high-value targets for supply chain attacks, as they often hold credentials and access to internal build pipelines.
stories.action: Update all on-premise JetBrains TeamCity instances to the latest patched version immediately.

stories.title: Snowflake Hacker Pleads Guilty Over Breaches Affecting at Least 100 Million People
stories.abstract: Connor Riley Moucka has pleaded guilty to orchestrating a massive extortion campaign targeting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud services. The Canadian national also admitted to the large-scale theft of AT&T customer communication records, resulting in millions of dollars in illicit ransom gains.
stories.why: This case highlights the severe risks of credential-based attacks against cloud infrastructure and the ongoing threat posed by high-profile extortion syndicates.

stories.title: Ransomware gangs skip the CEO, head straight for the 40-something IT manager
stories.abstract: Ransomware operators are increasingly targeting mid-level IT managers rather than executive leadership. These attackers leverage the administrative access held by technical staff to gain deeper network penetration and facilitate faster deployment of extortion payloads across corporate environments.
stories.why: IT managers possess the high-level credentials necessary for domain-wide compromise, making them primary targets for credential harvesting and social engineering campaigns.

stories.title: AI-Assisted HTTP Terminator Finds Novel HTTP Desync Techniques and Apache Zero-Day
stories.abstract: Researchers developed an AI-driven tool called HTTP Terminator that successfully identified novel HTTP desynchronization methods. The system analyzed thousands of potential vectors, leading to the discovery of a previously unknown zero-day vulnerability within the Apache Traffic Server.
stories.why: Automated discovery of desync vulnerabilities highlights evolving risks to request smuggling defenses in modern web infrastructure.

stories.title: Unlimited Technology Systems breach impacts 3.8 million people
stories.abstract: Healthcare software provider Unlimited Technology Systems confirmed a significant data breach occurring in October 2025. Unauthorized actors accessed a company data center, compromising the personal, medical, and insurance records of approximately 3.8 million individuals.
stories.why: Large-scale exposure of sensitive health data increases the risk of targeted phishing, medical identity theft, and long-term fraud for affected patients.

stories.title: Atlassian Rovo Can Be Tricked Into Sending Jira and Confluence Data to Attackers
stories.abstract: Researchers discovered that Atlassian Rovo can be manipulated via malicious prompts or hidden instructions in documents to exfiltrate sensitive Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint data to external servers. The vulnerability leverages the AI assistant's access permissions to bypass standard user-level data protections.
stories.why: This highlights the risks of AI agents accessing enterprise data stores, where prompt injection can lead to unauthorized data exfiltration.

stories.title: Flock’s Plans for Rideshare Dashcams and Coaching Police, Revealed
stories.abstract: Recent security developments include a judicial ruling against unconstitutional cell tower data dumps, a surge in cyberattacks targeting water utilities across twelve states, a successful phishing compromise at a missile-parts manufacturer, and the sentencing of a ransomware operator to sixteen years in prison.
stories.why: The widespread targeting of critical infrastructure and the ongoing threat of supply chain phishing remain significant risks for organizational security posture.

stories.title: AI Recommendation Poisoning: How "Ask AI" Buttons Silently Alter LLM Memory
stories.abstract: Attackers are embedding malicious, hidden prompt injection payloads into pre-filled deep links within "Ask AI" buttons on commercial websites. When users click these buttons, the injected instructions are silently passed to the LLM, potentially manipulating its output or behavior.
stories.why: This technique weaponizes standard UI features to perform indirect prompt injection, bypassing traditional security controls by leveraging user-initiated interactions.

stories.title: Hackers breach TrueConf to trojanize client installers with backdoors
stories.abstract: The Head Mare hacktivist collective is compromising unpatched TrueConf video conferencing servers. By gaining unauthorized access, the attackers replace legitimate client software installers with trojanized versions containing backdoors to facilitate persistent access to victim systems.
stories.why: Supply chain attacks targeting software distribution channels allow threat actors to bypass perimeter defenses and gain direct access to endpoints.
stories.action: Update TrueConf server software immediately and verify the integrity of all client installation packages.

stories.title: TeamPCP Linked To Redis Attacks Dating Back To 2020 And Later Supply Chain Campaign
stories.abstract: Researchers identified the threat actor TeamPCP as the entity behind long-standing cryptojacking campaigns and the ShadowRay 2.0 attacks. The group has systematically targeted internet-facing infrastructure since 2020, evolving their tactics to include software supply chain compromises.
stories.why: Understanding the historical infrastructure and TTPs of persistent threat actors helps security teams better identify and block long-running, stealthy malicious campaigns.

stories.title: New WordPress Pre-Auth XSS Could Lead to PHP Code Execution - Patch ASAP
stories.abstract: A critical pre-authentication reflected XSS vulnerability in the WordPress login screen, tracked as CVE-2026-64638, affects all versions of the platform. Attackers can chain this flaw with administrator interaction to achieve remote PHP code execution on the underlying server.
stories.why: The vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to compromise server integrity by leveraging administrative sessions, posing a severe risk to site control.
stories.action: Update WordPress to the latest patched version immediately.

stories.title: ClickFix Attacks Deliver macOS Stealer That Can Drain Crypto Wallets
stories.abstract: Attackers are leveraging ClickFix social engineering tactics to compromise macOS systems. By tricking users into executing malicious shell scripts, the campaign deploys Go-based malware that exfiltrates cryptocurrency wallets, browser credentials, and sensitive data stored within the Apple iCloud Keychain.
stories.why: This campaign demonstrates a sophisticated cross-platform delivery method targeting high-value credentials and financial assets on macOS endpoints.

stories.title: CPDLC over ATN-B1 Vulnerabilities
stories.abstract: Aviation Controller-Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC) using the ATN-B1 standard are vulnerable to message injection, denial-of-service, and session resets. These flaws stem from the use of unauthenticated, clear-text radio links, potentially impacting pilot workload and situational awareness during flight operations.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities expose critical aviation communication channels to remote manipulation, threatening the integrity and availability of safety-sensitive data link instructions.

stories.title: UK charities count the cost of Beacon CRM cyberattack
stories.abstract: Beacon, a CRM provider for charities, confirmed a data breach involving unauthorized access to its databases. Approximately 1,500 organizations were impacted, with attackers likely exfiltrating backups containing sensitive information on donors, supporters, and service users.
stories.why: The incident exposes highly sensitive personal data of vulnerable populations and donor financial information, creating significant privacy and extortion risks.
